literal_meaning: কথা দিয়ে কথা (শব্দশঃ অর্থে কথোপকথনের মাধ্যমে)
figurative_meaning_en: in the course of idle conversation or chit-chat
example_sentences_in_english: Night fell before we knew it while chatting.
We spent the afternoon chatting away.
note: This is a reduplicated expression common in colloquial Bengali to indicate time passing unnoticed during talk.
